description: The addresses of a CEP (Brazilian postal code), with latitude and longitude. We join CNEFE addresses, company records and census sectors. Use the prepared result instead of importing and joining those datasets. Addresses and census data reflect 2022. Census measures describe the sector, not an individual or the entire postal code. Income is not current purchasing power. Missing data is unknown; company counts do not measure foot traffic.

cep.description: 8 digits, with or without the hyphen.
